purpose: Teach: 俊輔/ノブ/ひで/裕子/京子/千尋/貞/みゆき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「俊輔いとこと一緒に遊ぼう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad mentioned that you should play with your cousin Shun-suke.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Natural conversational rhythm. Slight lift at the name to draw Sho in. Gentle — not commanding, just relaying what was said. Voice settled, like she's been waiting to tell him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとノブおじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got to meet Dad and Uncle Nobu today.
lines.style: Bright, quick opening. Eager energy but not loud. Small excitement in the delivery — proud that something happened. Slight rise on the names like he's checking she understands who he means. Natural kid pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ひでおじさんに会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying we should go visit Uncle Hide.
lines.style: Calm, reflective delivery. Slight pause before the suggestion, as if remembering. Gentle suggestion-shape in her voice, not directive. Warm undertone — she cares that he hears this. Trails slightly on Uncle Hide's name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと裕子おばさんの家でお茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I had tea at Aunt Yuko's house today.
lines.style: Immediate, matter-of-fact kid energy. Quick clip to the names. Small warmth on 'tea' — it was nice. No performance, just reporting what happened. Natural kid rhythm, honest delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「京子おばさんはお花の先生」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad says Aunt Kyoko is a flower arrangement teacher.
lines.style: Soft, informative rhythm. Slight wonder in her voice — she's sharing something she learned. Not lecturing. Gentle rise on 'flower arrangement' like it's a little special. Composed, almost musing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「千と千尋の神隠し」を観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I watched Spirited Away together today.
lines.style: Genuine pleasure in the voice. Quick, unguarded delivery. Slight emphasis on 'together' — that's what mattered. Kid brightness but honest and unselfconscious. Natural rhythm, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貞淑、つまり貞しい心を持つ事」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad teaches me that true virtue means having a faithful and honest heart.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverent delivery. Slower pace than her other lines. Careful with the concept — she's transmitting something her father said with quiet respect. Warm but serious. Pause before 'faithful and honest heart' — weight to those words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとみゆきおばさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I went to visit Aunt Miyuki today.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied delivery. Direct and warm. Small lift on 'Aunt Miyuki' like that visit was something good. Kid-honest tone, no dramatics. Quick, natural rhythm. Close-to-camera feeling — like she's sharing a small happiness.
